AI Image Generation Prompts

Hand with Network Nodes
Create a minimalist illustration of a human hand with fingertips touching connected network nodes. Silhouette style, solid fills only (no strokes). Hand in #141413, nodes in #E3DACC. Organic curves for hand, geometric circles for nodes. Central composition, no gradients. Warm, human, intelligent feeling.
Seedling with Geometric Elements
Design an illustration of a young plant seedling emerging from soil, with geometric shapes floating around. Silhouette style, fill-based only. Seedling in #141413, shapes in #E3DACC. Organic curves combined with geometric precision. Concept: growth, learning, potential.
Lightbulb with Organic Filament
Design a lightbulb where the filament is an abstract organic form like a star or flower. Silhouette style, solid fills. Bulb glass in #FAF9F5, internal shape in #141413. Hand-drawn organic feel with precise execution. Concept: ideas, inspiration, illumination.
Puzzle Piece with Organic Edges
Create an abstract puzzle piece where edges have both geometric and organic flowing curves. Filled with geometric pattern inside. Primary #141413 on #E3DACC background. Intricate detailed paths. Concept: complex problem-solving, fitting pieces together.
Two Hands Holding Geometric Shape
Illustration of two hands approaching from opposite sides, each holding one end of a floating geometric shape. Silhouette style, solid fills only. Hands in #141413, held object in #E3DACC. Concept: collaboration, building together.
Sun with Organic Rays
Create a sun where rays are organic flowing shapes like petals or leaves instead of traditional pointed rays. Silhouette style. Sun circle in #E3DACC, radiating organic shapes in #141413. Intricate paths. Concept: energy, growth, illumination.

Generic Style Prompt

Generic Style Prompt
Create an illustration in Anthropic design style characterized by: Silhouette style, solid fills only no strokes, no gradients. Colors: near-black ink (#141413) + warm oat (#E3DACC). Subject: [INSERT YOUR SUBJECT]. Human + technology themes encouraged, organic forms combined with geometric precision. Central focal point, layered complexity, rich detail. Feeling: warm, human, intelligent, craft-forward.
